data.one_liner: Customizable radio button widget for Flutter with animation and shape options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a radio button that can be styled in size, shape, colors, and inner‑dot appearance. It uses the same animation as the default Flutter radio button.
use_when: You need a radio button with custom shapes (circle, square, diamond) or colors.
You want consistent animation with the platform radio widget but with extra styling options.
avoid_when: You require a full form or validation framework.
You need a radio group manager beyond what Flutter already offers.
weaknesses: Only covers radio button UI, no extra form logic
